name: Hiroshi Yanaka
bio: Hiroshi Yanaka (家中 宏, Yanaka Hiroshi, March 10, 1958) is a Japanese actor, voice actor and narrator born in Tokyo. He is affiliated with Apte Pro. He was formerly affiliated with Seinenza Theater Company. His wife is fellow voice actress Miho Yoshida (吉田 美保, Yoshida Miho).
